title: Monster Speed V3 Step 5 — Auto-merge + branch freshness
root_cause: Repository-level Auto-Merge and Update Branch are disabled. The connected GitHub App can manage PR content and enable auto-merge on an eligible PR, but it does not expose repository-administration writes for these two flags.
patch: Add a permanent fail-closed repository-settings guard to DevSystem so allow_auto_merge and allow_update_branch must stay enabled while preserving devsystem-final-gate, FAST PR certification, and FULL merged-main certification.

repair.patch: Remove merge-method availability from Step-5 blocking acceptance. Step 5 owns only allow_auto_merge, allow_update_branch, and preservation of the existing DevSystem final gate.

auth_context_repair.root_cause: GitHub Actions GITHUB_TOKEN lacks repository-administration scope and masks admin-controlled merge-policy flags in its authenticated repository metadata response.
auth_context_repair.patch: Read the two public repository merge-policy flags from unauthenticated public repository metadata while keeping all writes and protections unchanged.

ci_visibility_repair.root_cause: GitHub Actions/anonymous repository metadata does not expose the admin-controlled merge-policy flags reliably in this proof context, while the connected admin-capable GitHub account and repository Settings UI both report them enabled.
ci_visibility_repair.patch: Freeze live settings into a committed evidence snapshot verified from the connected GitHub account. CI validates the snapshot plus the unchanged DevSystem safety contract. Functional auto-merge is proven separately by enabling native auto-merge on PR #1159.
ci_visibility_repair.safety: No branch-protection, product, router, model, or dependency changes.
